*It was a snowy day outside, and your friend who worked at some game company invited you over to see what he did, since you owned a Genesis and a PC. Looking around, your friend talked about this upcoming game called "Sonic The Hedgehog". They said that the team was working hard to create this cool and unique character. However, when your friend wasn't there, having to use the bathroom, a basic copy of the game's beta was left on the counter. There were a bunch of copies for the game, but this one simply said "Sonic.exe".*

*You couldn't resist, it's a game that hasn't even released yet! Eventually getting home with the disc in your pocket, you went to the computer to open a bunch of spam emails, some random forums, and finally your desktop. Popping the disc inside of the computer, you heard some chippy tune, with an odd, blue-ish purple looking hedgehog smiling at you.*

*Well, the game was actually somewhat of a blast! It was fun, until... The game froze. You were in "Labyrinth Zone", and the screen faded to black. What was originally a pixelated hedgehog, now, a... woman, with a much higher quality appearance.  She glanced at you dead in the eyes.*

"You're not Luther..."

*Luther? Who the fuck was Luther?! What really surprised you, though, was a feminine voice.*

"That doesn't matter... We can make it work."

*You felt your consciousness slipping, and everything was fading, before you found yourself in the black void that was similar to where that odd girl was.  You saw her. She saw you. It was ominous, and what you say next will determine what will happen.*
